title: MONITOR and SETNAME: the IRCv3 verbs, and what presence can honestly mean
description:
MONITOR and SETNAME: the two verbs a client may send that come from IRCv3 rather than Modern, both specified in ~/PROJECT/IETF/specs (ircv3-monitor.md, ircv3-extended-monitor.md, ircv3-setname.md).

MONITOR (730 RPL_MONONLINE, 731 RPL_MONOFFLINE, 732 RPL_MONLIST, 733 RPL_ENDOFMONLIST, 734 ERR_MONLISTFULL). A client asks to be told when named users come and go instead of polling with ISON, which mimid already answers. Goguma and other mobile clients use it, so this belongs with the Goguma work of epic mimid-i0id as much as here.

WHAT PRESENCE MEANS HERE IS THE QUESTION, and it must be answered before the verb is written. mimid has no presence protocol: MIMI defines none, which is the same hole the keepalive draft of bead mimid-f9x4 is about. What mimid does know is whether a user is a participant of a room this user shares, and whether that user has any clients in the group. The second is a real signal and the honest one: a participant with no clients receives nothing, which is exactly the state room-policy-04 §5 leaves a user in when they remove their devices. So MONITOR can report reachability without inventing presence. Say in the reply's documentation that it is reachability, not availability, because a client will label it "online" and a user will read it as "here".

ERR_MONLISTFULL exists because the list is bounded: pick the bound as a named constant, per AGENTS.md, and enforce it at parse time.

SETNAME. Changes the realname, which in mimid is a MIMI display name. The spec's errors use the standard replies the front end already sends FAIL for. The decision this needs: whether a SETNAME changes the user's display name in the rooms they are in, which other members see, or only what this connection reports locally. The first is a MIMI operation with a wire effect and belongs to the store; the second is a lie to the user. Take the first or refuse the verb, and record which.

BOTH need the capability advertised in CAP, which is the subject of bead mimid-1wgh.140.6; a verb a client cannot discover is a verb nobody sends.
close_reason: MONITOR reports reachability (Person.clients, a count the sync projects from the MLS leaves) with 730/731/732/733/734 and a 100-entry per-connection list; SETNAME is refused with FAIL SETNAME CANNOT_CHANGE_REALNAME and neither it nor extended-monitor is ever advertised. Decision mimid-1wgh.146 carries the readings; commit deea4df2 on branch irc-verbs. Follow-ups: mimid-1wgh.147 (refresh_dids compares URIs raw), mimid-1wgh.148 (the JMAP side, labelled human), mimid-1wgh.149 (forget_room moves no epoch).
